messages:
Evelyn (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pipeline, GTM focus, and partner updates. We'll do a rapid Q&A thread here. Please keep replies short so we can capture action items.
Tara - VP Sales: Numbers first 4ca: ARR coverage ~3.3x; demo->PO conversion moved to ~8.5% after the new seed plays.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Are we reallocating any paid budget to partner co-marketing this quarter?
Tara - VP Sales: Small reallocation: up to $30k for prioritized co-marketing pilots. Anything >$30k needs centralized sign-off.
Liam (Partnerships): Pilot partner asked for SAML SSO + webhook for user sync. Also asked for a short co-branded case study clause and a 5-business-day review SLA for collateral.
Ana (PM, Product): Engineering estimate for SAML + webhook spike: 2 devs x 10 days + 1 QA x 4 days. Can we treat this as a 2-week spike?
Rachel (Ops): If partner chooses Dedicated, Ops needs a one-off onboarding runbook + a temporary SLA template. I'll draft both.
Maya (Finance): Pilot pricing recommendation: 15% off list, time-limited to pilot period. Rev recognition: I'll send a short note to accounting.
Tara - VP Sales: Discount guardrails: AE-level approvals up to 15% pre-authorized; >15% requires RevOps + Sales exec approval. We'll add to the playbook.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Growth asks: please add partner attribution params for trials so we can measure funnel.
Ana (PM, Product): Adding tracking params and event schema to the spike ticket. Tagging with `partner-pilot-q1`.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll produce a 1-pager on co-sell vs referral flows for PMs/growth and post to #partnerships by Friday.
Evelyn (CEO): Action list recap: 1) Eng spike for SAML/webhooks (Ana + Eng). 2) Rachel drafts Dedicated runbook + temp SLA. 3) Liam writes partner motion 1-pager. 4) RevOps/Tara finalize discount bands. Follow-up sync scheduled next Tue 10AM PT.
all-hands-bot: Follow-up meeting created: "Partner Pilot Sync" Tue 10:00 AM PT (invites sent).
Tara - VP Sales: If anyone has blocking resource conflicts, DM me and Evelyn.
Evelyn (CEO): Thanks all 44d. Drop any remaining items into the calendar invite or the shared doc.
Ana (PM, Product): Spike ticket created and linked in the calendar invite.
Maya (Finance): I'll circulate the pilot billing/recognition note before the follow-up.
Liam (Partnerships): Sharing partner details in DM per NDA.
Evelyn (CEO): Closing thread.
